text:
aditya: Heads up — seeing 99th pct latency spikes for /dev/nvme2n1 on gnode-usw2-23 when GPU provisioning kicks off. GPU allocs stuck ~120s.
marie: Can you paste iostat and df? sounds like scrub/trim overlap.
aditya: Pasting iostat sample: ```
iostat -x 1 3
Device:         rrqm/s wrqm/s r/s   w/s  rsec/s  wsec/s  avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await   r_await w_await svctm  %util
nvme2n1         0.00   0.00  0.10 120.00   4.00  1200.00   10.33    5.40   70.90   0.10   70.90  1.30  95.00
```
marie: avgqu-sz 5.4 and await 70ms — that's high for a local nvme. Could be janitor deep-scan.
oliver: @aditya can you check janitor/cleaner logs? any deep-scan or fstrim spikes?
aditya: Checked: janitor triggered deep-scan due to wear >0.9 on that host. Started at 7098765400. Log snippet: "deep_scan_start nvme2n1 concurrency=3 target=full". Looks like concurrent deep scan + gpu attach.
jen: We have an IO cap of 50MB/s per host normally — maybe something changed in throttle controller after the kernel blk-mq tweak.
aditya: We rolled blk-mq qdisc changes last deploy — suspicious. Also seeing SMART temp creep.
srebot: scrub-throttle-controller: policy update applied at 7098765390 by deploy-bot (old policy removed).
marie: Oof. short-term mitigation: throttle janitor deeper or reduce concurrency when GPU backlog>5.
oliver: Short-term ops: drain the node from GPU pool and move pending allocs to fallback pool.
aditya: Kicking drain via API: ```bash
curl -XPOST https://infra-api.internal/nodes/gnode-usw2-23/actions -d '{"action":"drain"}'
```
jen: Note: moving nodes will increase latency in us-west for queued jobs — cost tradeoff but avoids failed allocs.
aditya: Action plan: 1) rollback blk-mq tweak (canary 20%), 2) patch janitor to honor gpu-provision backpressure and reduce deep-scan concurrency, 3) add SMART+temp guard to avoid starting heavy scrubs when temp>70C.
oliver: I'll set the node to DRAIN and migrate 3 running containers off it now.
srebot: deploy-bot: Rollback PR #842 proposed by aditya at 7098765490 — starting canary.
marie: Nice. Also open INF ticket for postmortem and capacity impact calc.
aditya: INF-3321 created (link internal). Adding iostat and janitor logs.
oliver: SMART output showed Temperature: 73C and some growing media_errors count — hardware rotation candidate.
jen: Schedule hardware rotate when drained.
marie: Escalation policy: if rollback doesn't reduce await to <20ms within 10m, page infra-pager.
aditya: Update: 8 minutes post-rollback avg await down to ~12ms on nvme2n1 and GPU allocs resumed.
oliver: Nice job :party_parrot: 
aditya: Will write the postmortem with root cause (blk-mq throttle behavior + janitor concurrency) and mitigation PR with safety checks.
marie: Thx. Please also add a metric alert for janitor_active_scans > 2 when gpu_provision_backlog > 5.
aditya: Will do. Closing thread once postmortem PR is up.
